title: fix(components,i18n): element blocks in renderers/basic draw their defaults in the page's language (objectui#12910)
body:
Fixes #12910
Clause-②: yes

New language-pack keys: `element.number.sourceUnresolved`, `element.image.noSource`, `element.recordPicker.sourceUnresolved` and the `element.metadataViewer.*` block, in all ten packs. No input, prop or export changes.

## What changed

The `element:*` blocks registered from `packages/components/src/renderers/basic` now draw their defaults in the page's language. Each default reads `@object-ui/i18n` through `useObjectTranslation`, the pattern PR #12909 used. Each inline `defaultValue` is the `en` pack's value, and `check:i18n-keys` keeps the two byte-identical.

| Block | Before (English literal) | After |
|---|---|---|
| `element:record_picker` prompt | Select a record… | `lookup.selectRecord` (en: Select record, zh: 选择记录) |
| `element:record_picker` busy | Loading… / Failed to load | `common.loading` / `list.loadErrorTitle` (en: Couldn’t load records) |
| `element:record_picker` empty | No records | `common.noData` (en: No data, zh: 暂无数据), the repeater's key |
| `element:record_picker` view panel title | This record picker’s data source could not be resolved | `element.recordPicker.sourceUnresolved` (new) |
| `element:number` error, no message | aggregate failed | `errors.unknown` (en: An unexpected error occurred.) |
| `element:number` view panel title | This metric’s data source could not be resolved | `element.number.sourceUnresolved` (new) |
| `element:definition-list` empty | No details | `common.noData` |
| `element:image` without `src` | no image source | `element.image.noSource` (new) |
| `element:metadata_viewer` | every line | `element.metadataViewer.*` (new, 22 keys) |

- **An authored value still wins.** The picker applies its default before `pickLocalized`, so an authored string, an inline locale map and an authored empty string all pass through. All three are pinned under zh-CN, for both `emptyText` and `placeholder`.
- **No-message rejections.** A picker read that rejects with no message used to be treated as empty. The `''` message was falsy, so the control looked enabled. It now shows the error state. `element:number` does the same and draws `errors.unknown`. A thrown message is still shown as thrown.
- **Metadata viewer chips.** Metadata names are still drawn as code chips. Each chip's slot is interpolated with a private-use mark and the translated sentence is split on it, so each language decides where the chip sits. Counts now read "Steps: 3", "Technical steps hidden: 1" and "Object access: 2". That way no key needs a plural family in any pack: all three are on the count-neutral tally list.
- **English copy changes**, from reusing keys: No records becomes No data (picker), No details becomes No data, Select a record… becomes Select record, Failed to load becomes Couldn’t load records, and aggregate failed becomes An unexpected error occurred. The metadata viewer's loading, failed and not-found lines are now one sentence each across the three view kinds.
- **Descriptions.** The `placeholder`, `emptyText` and `items` input descriptions now name the active language's default and its key. No generated file copies them; only CHANGELOG history matches. `record-picker-inputs-spec-parity` (input names) is green.

## Pins (beside the renderers)

- `renderers/basic/__tests__/element-i18n-defaults-12910.test.tsx`: a zh-CN render of each changed default, the authored-value arms, and en, thrown-message and authored-`src` controls.
- `renderers/basic/__tests__/element-english-defaults-census-12910.test.ts`: the enumeration pin. It is a test, not a repo gate. It reads the TypeScript AST of every `.tsx` here that registers with `namespace: 'element'` and flags JSX text, display-attribute literals, JSX-child literals and prose-shaped `??` / `||` fallbacks. Not judged: `t()` calls, the registration call, and the identifier text inside code chips. A population control (5 files, each seen reading the bundle) and lit controls for every shape keep it from passing vacuously. Run over the base tree it finds 57 hits in 4 files; at head it finds 0.
- Deliberately edited: the two ABSENT-key pins (`record-picker-empty-text-i18n` now renders 暂无数据, `record-picker-label-placeholder-i18n` 选择记录, both under zh-CN), plus the English assertions in `record-picker.contractEnvelope-6726`, `element-list-inputs-11168`, `data-list.test`, `count-families-11445` and `de-quote-pairing-3876` (88 to 90).

**Ablations** ran on committed HEAD `1db43d6` through `ablation-replace.mjs`, each with "ok mutation landed" and "ok restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty". All eight went red:
- picker empty literal: 3 failed, including the census;
- picker authored emptyText ignored: 3 failed;
- picker authored placeholder ignored: 3 failed;
- picker loading literal: 2 failed;
- number fallback: 2 failed;
- definition-list: 2 failed;
- image: 2 failed;
- metadata-viewer badge: 2 failed.

The first metadata-viewer attempt was a no-op, refused before any test ran because the replacement text sat inside the anchor. I re-ran it with a distinct spelling.

## Verification (head 1db43d6)

- Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' run build`: exit 0. Type-check of `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/i18n`: exit 0.
- `packages/components/` in 4 shards: 406 files, all passed. `packages/i18n/`: passed. The family set (87 files naming the five blocks): 3251 tests passed. Controls from PR #12909 and the parity pins: passed.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-dead-keys`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `test-path-roots`, `new-line-citations`, `check-changeset-presence`, `pending-changeset-literals`, `control-bytes`, `unreferenced-sources`, `phantom-deps`: all exit 0. eslint on the changed files: 0 errors and no new warnings.
- Bundle: the en pack source grows 578 bytes gzipped, comments included. The CI Bundle Analysis reading is pending.

## Acceptance notes

- Same family, out of scope: 16 plugin `errorTitle` literals that read "This X’s data source could not be resolved" (calendar, charts, dashboard ×2, detail ×2, form ×4, gantt, grid, kanban, list, map, timeline). The `@object-ui/react` panel defaults also stay English. They are reported for the seat to file.
- The C / R / U / D column letters in the permission table are a mnemonic whose tooltip is the permission key name. They are identifiers, not copy, and stay as they are.
